rules.name: ouat178-migration-cutoff
rules.sql: SELECT created_timestamp::date AS created_day, count(*) AS deals, min(created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(created_timestamp) AS last_created, max(created_by) AS created_by FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' AND created_timestamp >= :from_ts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'underlying_settle_value_table' AS tbl, max(value_date)::text AS newest_date, max(created_timestamp) AS newest_created FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table UNION ALL SELECT 'var_price_vol_table', max(settlement_date)::text, max(created_timestamp) FROM opera.var_price_vol_table UNION ALL SELECT 'security_settlement_value_table CFS', max(value_date)::text, max(created_timestamp) FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'valuation_date_table CFS', max(value_date)::text, max(created_timestamp) FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT 'underlying_settle_value_table' AS tbl, CAST(MAX(value_date) AS CHAR) AS newest_date FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table UNION ALL SELECT 'var_price_vol_table', CAST(MAX(settlement_date) AS CHAR) FROM dbsystemuat.var_price_vol_table UNION ALL SELECT 'security_settlement_value_table_cfs', CAST(MAX(value_date) AS CHAR) FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs
SELECT value_date, COUNT(*) AS rows_all, SUM(security_id LIKE 'CM WP%') AS wp_rows FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date DESC LIMIT 8

expect.reason: UAT has CFS deals created after the start date
